scope: Bounded single-owner in-memory candidate, dependency and attempt scheduling; no durable journal, OS/device enforcement, real proving worker or host lifecycle integration.

implementation.feature_gate: block-v2; no default verifier, proof format, ABI or production activation change
implementation.admission: Append-only existing dependencies, recomputed ordered merge semantics, bounded metadata/artifacts, full-depth nonempty candidate attachment.
implementation.identity: Immutable semantic jobs; first-admitted randomized wallet artifacts retained; leases freeze exact ordered input digests and bytes.
implementation.lifecycle: Explicit host eligibility stamp, seal/cancel, earliest-deadline then higher-ready-level ordering, session/epoch fencing, idempotent completion and monotonic time.
implementation.verification: Only CPU-verified private job tickets can publish results. Structural tests use explicitly cfg(test)-only synthetic tickets; production constructors are unchanged.
implementation.reservations: Aggregate RAM/VRAM/scratch/threads and maximum output space reserved before dispatch; cancellation/expiry retain reservation until authoritative worker stop and verification completion.
implementation.pruning: No graph pruning while any reservation remains unreleased; recovery window begins at actual attempt release; retained parents preserve full dependency closure.
implementation.boundaries: Caller must drive monotonic time and stop/verification acknowledgements. Ledger is not OS/device enforcement. Host spend eligibility is external. New sessions fence handles, not surviving OS workers.

initial.reason: A test incorrectly required a ready level-one parent to outrank already-ready higher-level padding. Corrected to assert readiness and the documented ordering; no implementation relaxation.

checks: release CPU test build with block-v2-wide-lanes,stream
tar --compare of every archived source file

Shared candidate cancellation, exact eligibility/sealing, time-aware result lookup and incremental prefix reuse.
Wrong-job/changed-byte/failed CPU tickets and worker failure never publish dependencies.
Aggregate RAM/VRAM/scratch/thread/output-space/deadline checks and bounded metadata history.
Fresh-session handle fencing and transitive pruning closure.

Separate existing eight-wallet/root CPU replay; NOT real-worker/DAG proof generation.
remaining: Durable journal and artifact store, crash recovery, CPU revalidation and surviving-worker reconciliation.
Real bounded CPU/GPU worker adapters and OS/device resource enforcement.
Arrival-driven correctness and latency harness; host-callable submit/status/seal/cancel integration.
GPU data movement and per-proof performance work with matched qualification.
Full64 cold and complete post-seal gates, full transaction types, complete-tree soundness/ZK review, host integration and explicit activation.
